CALLER STATED THAT A SMALL AMOUNT OF THE LIQUID ANHYDROUS AMMONIA WAS FOUND ON THE SOIL. THE CALLER STATED THAT LOCAL POLICE WERE NOTIFIED TO MAKE A REPORT OF THE POTENTIAL THEFT.

Suspected Responsible Party: HECK OHIO INVESTMENTS
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 39.755024, -84.184750 (Approximated from CITY_STATE)
Report Description
CALLER IS REPORTING A RELEASE OF PHOSPHINE GAS INTO THE ATMOSPHERE DUE TO A NEIGHBOR OVER FERTILIZING THEIR PARCEL THAT IS MIXING WITH THE LOCAL GROUND WATER AND WOLF CREEK PRODUCING THE GAS. WOLF CREEK IS ABOVE THE AQUIFER AND IS PROTECTED LAND. THE GASES ARE CAUSING THE LOCAL RESIDENTS AND PETS TO BECOME SICK WITH NEUROLOGICAL AND DIGESTIVE ISSUES. THE GASES ARE BUBBLING UP THROUGH THE GROUND. THE FARMS THAT ARE RECEIVING THE FERTILIZER ARE AFFECTING THE 70 ACRE PARCEL OF THE CALLERS AND POSSIBLY OTHERS. THE NATURAL FLOW OF WATER HAS ALSO BEEN DIVERTED CAUSING THE CALLERS PROPERTY TO BE UNDER WATER. LOCAL WILDLIFE HAS BEEN SEEN DYING OFF AS WELL (RACCOONS, PUPPIES, HERON)

properties.summary: Incident Type: FIXED - NRC Report ID: 894285 - Medium Affected: LAND - Suspected Responsible Party: JERRY'S AUTO WRECKING
properties.content:

Nearest City: Coraopolis, PA
Incident Type: FIXED
Material: OIL, FUEL: NO. 2-D
Medium Affected: LAND
Suspected Responsible Party: JERRY'S AUTO WRECKING
Skytruth Analysis
THE SUSPECTED RESPONSIBILE PARTY CRUSHES AUTOMOBILES ON HIS PREMISES AND AT OTHER YARDS. WHEN THE ISSUE OF CRUSHING AUTOMOBILES, WITHOUT REMOVING FLUIDS AROSE, HE MAINTAINS THAT HE DRAINS ALL OF THE FLUIDS OUT OF THE CARS BEFORE CRUSHING AND RECYCLING FLUIDS THROUGH EVERCLEAR. FLUIDS ARE STORED IN 55 GALLON DRUMS THAT WERE NOT PROPERLY MARKED. HE PUT A TRUCK ON THE DRAINING LIFT AND QUIT DRAINING FLUIDS AND CONTINUED CRUSHING THE AUTOMOBILES WITH THE OIL AND OTHER FLUIDS IN THEM. HE DID PLACE 5 GALLON BUCKETS UNDER THE DRAIN PARTS OF THE CRUSHER. WHEN THE BUCKETS WERE FULL, HE DUMPED THEM INTO A VEHICLE TO BE CRUSHED. SOMETIMES, THE BUCKETS WERE LEFT UNDER THE CRUSHER AND WHEN IT RAINED RISING WATER TOOK CARE OF THE OIL. THEN THE WATER WAS DUMPED ON THE GROUND.

Incident Type: UNKNOWN SHEEN
Material: UNKNOWN OIL
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party:
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 28.935833, -88.970000 (Explicit)
Report Description
****NESDIS**** POSSIBLE OIL SEEN ORIGINATING FROM TAYLOR PLATFORM. OIL EXTENDS AS FAR AS 27 MILES SOUTHEAST OF PLATFORM VISIBLE IN 4 SEGMENTS BETWEEN CLOUD FEATURES. THE SEGMENT CLOSEST TO THE POINT SOURCE IS APPROXIMATELY 2.4 MILES LONG AND 0.6 MILES WIDE. FOLLOWING THIS, ANOTHER SEGMENT IS SEEN THAT IS 3 MILES LONG AND 1 MILE WIDE. FOLLOWING THIS, THE LONGEST SEGMENT SEEN IS 14.5 MILES LONG AND 1.8 MILES WIDE AT THE LARGEST WIDTH. THE FINAL SEGMENT IS ORIENTED NORTHEAST TO SOUTHEAST AND IS 4.6 MILES LONG AND 0.7 MILES WIDE. DIRECTION OF SLICK IS CONSISTENT WITH OCEAN CURRENT DATA AS WELL AS IMAGERY OF SHEEN SEEN IN YESTERDAYS IMAGERY. UNCERTAINTIES: THE SUSPECTED OIL SLICK LIKELY ORIGINATING FROM THE TAYLOR SITE DOES NOT SHOW UP HAS WELL-DEFINED AS IT DID YESTERDAY. THIS IS PRIMARILY DUE TO LIGHT SURFACE WINDS AND OIL IS NOT IN SUN GLINT. CLOUD FEATURES ARE OBSCURING PART OF THE SLICK MAKING IT HARD TO DISCERN FULL EXTENT OF OIL NEAR THE PLATFORM. HOWEVER FEATURE IS ALIGNED WITH OCEAN CURRENT DIRECTION, AND THE FACT THAT THE OIL SLICK DIRECTION IS CONSISTENT WITH YESTERDAYS ANALYSIS, INCREASES CONFIDENCE.
